statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent palpitations and episodes of syncope
There is concern for underlying arrhythmia
Paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and supraventricular tachycardia are identified as potential etiologies
Diagnosis codes I47.1, I48.0, and R55 were submitted
The claim was denied with reason code PR-204
A cardiac event monitor is medically necessary to capture rhythm data during symptomatic episodes to guide further management
